verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS payroll/PEO platform. However, the evidence pack documents only UI-driven workflows (payroll, benefits, time off, Xero integration) and never mentions a command-line tool. The probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404s, so nothing here shows that Justworks ships an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
